title: The Tangible Reward Ladder
description: Six recognition tools on six rungs, ordered by the size of the thing they mark.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Motivation, Badges, and Growth Mindset Coaching

educational.audience: Club leaders designing a recognition system

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given an unlabeled illustration of a six-rung ladder, the learner identifies which reward tool sits at each rung and what scale of accomplishment it marks.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover any rung for the tool that sits there and the scale of accomplishment it marks
pedagogical.assessment: Place a described accomplishment on the right rung.
